data.gender_notes: Kamitha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kamitha is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it is the name of the goddess of desire and love in Hindu mythology. The name Kamitha is believed to represent the feminine aspect of the divine, embodying passion, creativity, and sensuality. According to Hindu scriptures, Kamitha is the wife of Lord Kama, the god of love. She is also known as Rati, the goddess of sexual pleasure and marital happiness. The name Kamitha is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and is considered a powerful and auspicious name for a girl.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of love, passion, and creativity
data.etymology: Kamitha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Desire, Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamitha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Kamitha is also an essential part of Hindu religious rituals, especially those related to marriage and fertility.
